policy_title: Roll Out Mobile Pay-As-You-Go Contactless Tickets Nationwide
stated: The Conservative Party will roll out mobile pay-as-you-go contactless tickets nationwide for rail services over the next Parliament.

source.quote: Over the next Parliament, we will also roll out mobile pay as you go contactless tickets nationwide, bringing rail into line with how we pay for many goods and services.

bearing_set.reason: Nationwide contactless pay-as-you-go rail ticketing would reduce friction and cost of travel for ordinary households, potentially lowering effective fares versus advance/fixed tickets and improving real disposable income for commuters.

Reducing ticketing friction for rail travel nationwide lowers a demonstrated barrier to labour-market access and economic mobility, particularly outside London where complex advance-purchase requirements currently deter occasional use — a real if modest effect on economic opportunity indicators.

membership_note: The policy is primarily a digital-payment convenience improvement for rail. Without explicit fare-capping provisions, no direct effect on travel costs (O2) is established by the stated text. Effects on other fundamentals — housing, healthcare, workers' rights, public finances — are too indirect to clear the non-negligible bar. One genuine bearing: O13, via improved rail accessibility and economic mobility.
